'''Ihouse''' was an establishment in a seedy part of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], situated next to [[Purple Werm/Legends|Purple Werm]] and across the street from [[Sleeping Rose/Legends|Sleeping Rose]]. An [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] neon sign spelled out the name.<ref name="HH" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] stayed in an apartment opposite Ihouse, while planning the [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|Mission to the Jedi Temple]].<ref name="HH" />

[[File:Ihouse_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|120px|Concept art of Ihouse]]

==Behind the scenes==
During pre-production, the establishment was known as "Gala", as seen in concept art of the Coruscant underworld.<ref name="SW-Holocron Heist - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep201|text="Holocron Heist" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|[https://www.starwars.com/series/clone-wars/holocron-heist-concept-art-gallery Concept Art Gallery], slide 10}}</ref>
